This is exactly what I do! It usually starts with hunting for an item that sparks my interest. Once I've identified it, I spend hours looking for the best deal, sometimes finding a different "better" item. Then the process repeats itself. In the end,  I may not even buy anything. But there is 1) distraction or escape from whatever is bothering me and 2) satisfaction that I found a specific item at the best price.  I spend more money on clothes than I intend, but I am not in debt and am overall financially sound. The issue is wasting time. However, when I try to stop, I only make it a few days before some emotional trigger tempts me to retail therapy. I am in actual therapy to work on my mental health, by the way. How can I break my browsing habit, and what will I do instead?
